🇮🇳🤝🇦🇷 Rotary Friendship Exchange – A Cultural Exchange at Colegio Nuevo Surco, Argentina

Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown | District 3141, India
Rotary Friendship Exchange 2026–27 | District 4895, Argentina

As part of the Rotary Friendship Exchange to Argentina, the delegation from Rotary Club of Bombay Uptown, District 3141, visited Colegio Nuevo Surco, Argentina, for an enriching interaction with primary and secondary school students.

The visit was a wonderful celebration of culture, education and international friendship. The students enthusiastically showcased the rich cultural heritage of Argentina, giving the visiting Indian Rotarians a glimpse into their traditions, lifestyle and cultural identity.

An engaging interactive question-and-answer session brought students and delegates together, encouraging curiosity, dialogue and the sharing of experiences. The interaction also provided an opportunity for the students to learn about Indian culture, traditions and diversity.

The exchange extended beyond classroom discussions, with conversations about Argentine delicacies, traditional food, dance and cultural practices. The students' enthusiasm and the delegates' participation created a lively atmosphere of mutual learning and appreciation.

The visit demonstrated how cultural exchanges can broaden young minds, nurture respect for different traditions and build friendships across countries. It was a memorable experience for both the students and the visiting Rotarians, reinforcing the value of connecting communities through education and cultural understanding.

🌎 Two Cultures • Shared Learning • Friendships Without Borders

This meaningful school visit beautifully reflected the spirit of the Rotary Friendship Exchange—bringing people together, celebrating diversity and strengthening the bond between District 3141, India, and District 4895, Argentina.
